method: 20 simulated mathematical lenses in three panel contexts (7/7/6), followed by source/prior-work cross-checks, exact tests and cross-review. Not20 independent scientists; applicability scores are judgments, not probabilities GU is true or false.
target: LB-CLASS; held candidate receiver strategy with explicit source bridge limits

lenses.specialty: Numerical linear algebra and validated computing
lenses.route: Compute only the required dual response functional, using an exact adjoint witness and residual certificate, before constructing the full reduced force.
lenses.why_better: A question about one scalar interaction or energy channel need not require a 49,154-component inverse. The already certified spin6/7 blocks demonstrate that right-hand-side structure matters more than ambient matrix size.

If solvable and j_N annihilates ker M, the scalar j_R(v)−j_N(y) is well-defined without a global inverse. In a general nonsymmetric coordinate formulation solve the adjoint system; never replace adjoint by the same primal matrix. A residual zero check must be in the FULL equation, not merely the projected block.

Kernel compatibility of j_N is checked if M is singular
Boundary terms or compact core specified for differential adjoints

lenses.do_not: Invert every lower rotation block or silently use a pseudoinverse as a physical selector. Nonzero scalar work still does not determine forced-response energy.

Add finite lemmas only where needed: kernel-annihilation makes the scalar witness independent of the chosen solution; wrong adjoint and PSD rank-relaxation examples are controls.

Every finite lemma names its input equations and pairing
No placeholder axioms for the missing physical map

lenses.do_not: Count a successful Lean check as validation that the formal statement matches the native construction. Do not turn this map into a new work/stop governance rule.

lenses.specialty: Convex optimization, source cones and semidefinite certificates

A positivity certificate on a larger PSD relaxation is sound for the pure subset; a negative relaxed minimum needs a realizable rank-one/amplitude witness or another proved native realization map.

lenses.route: Use probabilistic mixtures only as an explicitly one-sided mathematical relaxation; test whether claimed conclusions require correlations or a state law the source has not supplied.

Response energy is generally quadratic in rho; the same extreme-point inference fails. The exact control q(rho)=−det rho vanishes on every rank-one 2×2 PSD state but is −1/4 on I/2.
